title: Critical gain for K/(s + 1)³
caption: The phase is −180° at ω = √3, where |L| = K/8. At the critical K = 8 the gain there is exactly 1, so the locus passes through −1; any K < 8 keeps it clear.
alt: The gain curve 8/(1 + ω²)^{3/2} falling from 8; it crosses the level 1 at ω = √3 ≈ 1.73.
description: The phase of 1/(s + 1)³ is −3 arctan ω; it equals −180° when ω = √3.
The locus touches −1 when K/8 = 1: stable for K < 8.
